project_type: Full-stack AI validation platform - Python Flask backend + Vue 3 frontend
build_system: uv (Python package manager), npm (Node.js), Docker + docker-compose
test_framework: pytest with class-based test fixtures, mock patching for singletons
test_command: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v
verification_instructions: 1. Run backend tests: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v. 2. Build frontend: cd frontend && npm run build. 3. Verify syntax with python -c imports.
setup_instructions: 1. npm install (root). 2. cd frontend && npm install. 3. cd backend && uv sync.
environment_constraints: No external API keys available for integration tests. Tests mock LLM/Serper calls. SQLite used for memory store (file-based or :memory:).
contribution_requirements: Flask app factory pattern, Blueprint routing, service layer separation. Commit prefixes: feat:, fix:, chore:. Follow existing code patterns.
key_patterns: Singleton pattern with _instance/_lock for MemoryStore and MemoryService. create_app() factory in app/__init__.py. Blueprint-based API routes. ThreadPoolExecutor not yet used (bare threading.Thread). Tests use setup_method/teardown_method with mock patches on module-level singletons.
directory_structure: Root: Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, package.json. backend/: Flask app in app/ with api/, services/, models/, utils/ subdirs. tests/ for pytest. frontend/: Vue 3 SPA with src/api/, src/views/, src/router/.
